scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -n "frontend,backend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: npx -y concurrently -n "frontend,backend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run build:frontend" "npm run build:backend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
